learning_objective: 🎯 Let us step outside to explore the magical garden and meet the tiny creatures living there!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A garden is full of bright, colourful flowers. They smell very sweet and dance when the wind blows.
Look closely at the leaves! You might see a red ladybug, a busy bee, or a pretty butterfly resting there.
Big trees give us cool shade on sunny days. Little birds build their cozy nests high up in the branches.

fun_activity.title: 🍃 Leaf Collection
fun_activity.instructions: Go to a park or your garden. Collect three fallen leaves of different shapes and trace them in your notebook!

quick_recap: ⭐ Gardens are full of lovely flowers and tall trees.
⭐ Many tiny friends like butterflies and ladybugs live in the garden.
⭐ We should take care of plants and not pluck flowers.
